content: . . . I knew it. I always knew you were a lesbian!
She's my roommate, not my date. [to Yi-jun] The D-man, as in dork.
Haha. Still got that great sense of humor, I see. Here's my card. I sell used cars. A car from us is a car you can trust!
Alrighty then. Didn't you use to date Sheryl?
Sweet little lassie. Yep, broke her heart when the D-man told her he couldn't be a one-woman guy.
Oh? I heard she dumped you. Anyway, she's right over there. Oh, Sheryl!
